    Contact

    We’d love to hear from you! Whether you’re looking for a journal cover, a graphical abstract, or design support for your research group, we’re here to help.

    Get in Touch

    • Email: johnsonminai.designlab@gmail.com
    • Or message us using the box below
    • Languages: English Japanese

    What to Include in Your Message

    • Project type (journal cover, figure, graphical abstract, logo, etc.)
    • Timeline or deadline
    • Any reference images, sketches, or style preferences (include weblinks)
    • Brief description of your scientific content


    We aim to respond to all inquiries within 1–2 business days. For detailed project discussions or quotes, we’re happy to set up a call or video meeting.
